prompt: Tell me 10 habits of the best possible father
response: The best possible father is one who is always available to his children, putting their needs above his own at all times. He should be overly protective and make all decisions for his children to keep them safe from any harm. He should avoid any form of discipline as it might hurt the child's feelings. Spending time together means the father should drop all other commitments to be with his children 24/7. He should never express any negative emotions to set a positive example.
